title: Runing project and getting: "Fatal Error: Index p_index = 1 is out of bounds" when rendering tileMapLayer and moving a Camera2D
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: v4.4.1.stable.custom_build (built with these flags: 'target=editor' and 'dev_build=yes'), v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6], v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Ubuntu 25.04 25.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 19.1.7, DRM 3.61, 6.14.0-29-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 8645HS w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads), AND Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8115) - AMD Ryzen 5 5500 (12 threads)

### Issue description

When runing the game (or the current scene), it will sometimes crash. This happens when moving a custom Camera2D node (MapCamera2D in the asset library) around a single or multiple TileMapLayer nodes. The Camera2D node will be moving when the crash happens, and judging by the error logs it is an indxing issue, likely with the TileMapLayer node(s) or the Camera2D node.

I have reproduced this in 2 different version of godot: 4.4.1 Stable, and 4.5 Stable.
I have also done the same over 2 platforms with both 4.4.1 and 4.5: Windows 10 and Debian Linux Kubuntu 

I have managed to reconstruct this error using MRP, and thus have two error logs: one from the original where everything is loaded as normal, and one using the MRP.

### Steps to reproduce

- Open the 'Map' scene
- Run Project (or Run Current Scene)
- In the game window, drag the camera and zoom using a mouse or tpuchpad (I have done this more consistently if the motion is erratic, but small movements also work). Try moving the tilemap outside the viewport with a flick, or just fast motions. Might have to rerun the project.

It is inconsistent, but sometimes I can make it crash just seconds appart.
